name: Planche Lean
steps: Assume a high-plank position on the floor with your hands shoulder-width apart, fingers turned slightly outward, elbows locked straight, and toes pointed back.
Protract your shoulder blades firmly to round your upper back slightly and squeeze your abs and glutes into a tight hollow body line.
Shift your shoulders forward past your wrists while keeping your feet grounded and your body straight.
Hold the lean while breathing steadily, then shift your weight back to your toes.
tips: Warm up your wrists thoroughly and lean only as far forward as you can hold with completely straight arms.
Do not let your hips sag downward or pike high as you increase the forward lean.
